name: Shenzhen H&T Intelligent Control Co.Ltd
summary: Shenzhen H&T Intelligent Control Co.Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, researches and develops, manufactures, sells, and markets intelligent controller products in China and internationally. Its household appliances include washing machine, oven, dryer, air conditioner, air fryer, vacuum cleaner, dishwasher, stove, refrigerator, and air purifier control boards; and power tools comprise lawn mower and slotting machine control boards, battery management systems, tool lamps, and chargers. The company also offers automotive solutions, such as hands-off detection and DGSC controllers, right-zone control units, and coolant side integrated and electric compressor controllers; ceiling fans control boards and garage door openers; AI adaptive mattresses and intelligent mattress selection systems; sofa, desk, and chair solutions; haptic suit smart solutions; smart eye mask and cushion solutions; and spine-protective backpack, and foot and spine health monitoring solutions. In addition, it provides residential, commercial, and industrial energy storage solutions; and BLDC ceiling fan, low-noise BLDC inner rotor, and magnetic positioning reciprocating brushless linear motors. The company serves various industries, such as home appliances, power tools, automotive, energy storage, and internet of things. Shenzhen H&T Intelligent Control Co.Ltd was founded in 2000 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
